reply.text:
I don't know which question "Which one?" was answering, so I can't tell which field to fill. The athlete is unsure and gave no value, so I won't guess a field.

For most beginners, the best choice is the simplest one: a few full-body or upper/lower sessions a week, built around basic lifts, with time to learn the movements before piling on volume. Tell me what you're after, whether that's getting stronger, building muscle, or just getting in shape, and how many days a week feel doable. I'll hand it to the app to build from there.
